leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a status card component that displays dynamic status information
Configure component properties to accept status data through input binding
Apply conditional styling based on status type using ngClass directive
Construct a reusable card template with proper Angular component structure
Bind dynamic content to display status messages and icons
Integrate the status card component into a parent component
Manipulate component state to update status information dynamically
Control visual appearance using Angular's built-in directives and property binding
